persona.name: standard
persona.description: Average small business owner with basic web literacy. Has a clear business goal and can make decisions about content and design without hand-holding.

goals.description: The agent creates a multi-page website with a homepage, a product catalog page with category filtering, and an about page with team member profiles
The product catalog page loads product data from a service module or API endpoint rather than hardcoding product information directly in component markup
All pages share a consistent navigation header and footer through a reusable layout component
